mapper.select: select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey} order by config_id asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_config (config_name, config_key, config_value, config_type, create_by, create_time, remark) select '媒体库站端编辑策略', #{configKey}, #{configValue}, 'N', 'admin', SYSDATE(), '站端编辑策略：off=站端禁止编辑 / local=只在浏览器本地改（服务端拒写） / full=完全编辑（默认）' from DUAL where not exists (select 1 from sys_config where config_key = #{configKey})
mapper.update: update sys_config set config_value = #{configValue}, update_time = SYSDATE() where config_key = #{configKey}
